title: inspect.getargspec was removed in Python 3.11: use getfullargspec or signature

files.check.py:
from intro import params


def f(a, b=2, *rest, **kw):
    pass


assert params(f) == ['a', 'b'], params(f)
assert params(lambda: 0) == []

limitations.does_not_prove: Keyword-only parameters (getargspec refused them; getfullargspec reports them separately).
